name: gap_momentum_continuation
mechanism: When NIFTY gaps >0.3% at the open due to overnight global cues (SGX Nifty, US futures, Asia markets), institutional desks carry a directional bias established before the bell. The first 15 minutes (09:15-09:30) acts as a price-discovery absorption window where algos benchmark against overnight gamma. When price breaks above the 15-minute opening range high on a bullish gap (or below the range low on a bearish gap) accompanied by a volume surge, it signals that resting institutional buy (or sell) interest has overwhelmed the supply ceiling, and TWAP/VWAP algorithms begin chasing fills — creating a 30-90 second momentum continuation window. At 5-second resolution, we can enter at the breakout bar itself rather than waiting for a full minute confirmation.
core_signal_oneliner: Gap > 0.3% day: first 5s close above 15-min ORB high (gap-up) or below ORB low (gap-down) with volume > 1.5x 20-min average
